clips.title: The story
paras: In Camp Taurajo, Mangletooth offers travelers a blood shard ritual. The captive quilboar channels the power of his ancient boar god, blessing those who bring him shards from the Barrens with swift movement and sure aim.

Crimson blood shards jut from the Barrens soil, especially near quilboar encampments and colossal brambles. Quilboar tradition says the crystals formed from Agamaggan's spilled blood. The Great Boar Ancient fell fighting the Burning Legion in the War of the Ancients. Even locked in a wooden cage at Camp Taurajo, the elder quilboar Mangletooth knows how to channel the stones' dormant divine power for anyone who brings them.

Quilboar hunters and scouts prize ruthless accuracy and blinding quickness in the scrublands. For four blood shards, Mangletooth calls on the fallen demi-god's latent energy, lending the petitioner the instincts and supple grace of his people's best stalkers. He grunts with disdain at outsiders, yet honors his pact and weaves Agamaggan's power into a temporary mantle of agility.

clips.title: Progress
paras: My tribes greatest scouts are said to be unrivaled in their accuracy, and no rogue could measure up to their quickness in battle.
Bring me 4 blood shards and I will make you even more agile than any quilboar born.

clips.title: Completion
paras: May your aim be unerring, and the mark of your weapon be true, traveler.
Agamaggan's spirit is with you. Return to me if you wish. Mangletooth will bless you again if the great boar god deems me worthy.
